page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by custom AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. This server features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring no resource sharing at the CPU level. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core.

The instance includes 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, offering high-speed local read and write capabilities directly attached to the hypervisor. Built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor, the c9gd.8xlarge delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture combined with dedicated physical cores offers high compute density and lower power consumption compared to traditional x86 architectures. The integration of local NVMe SSD storage reduces the need for external block storage, optimizing costs for data-intensive operations. This hardware profile is suited for compute-heavy workloads that require fast local scratch space, such as distributed analytics, ad-hoc data processing, batch workloads, and high-performance web serving.
